releases.name: First Release
releases.body: ```bash opencode plugin add @jakedowns/progress-tool-opencode-plugin@^2.18.0 ``` # @jakedowns/progress-tool-opencode-plugin First release! An OpenCode plugin that gives agents a fire-and-forget progress tool and an out-of-band relay for long-running commands — a live, glance-able tree above the transcript, at zero model tokens for telemetry. ## Features - **`progress` tool** — dual purpose: a drop-in replacement for todo/task trackers (tree of tasks, parent/child roll-up) and a milestone reporter. - **`list` tool** — read-only view of your session's trees, with dismissed items hidden. - **`progress-relay`** — wraps long commands so stdout/stderr drive the UI (`progress-relay --id build-1 -- npm run build`); exit code maps to done/error, and `OSC 9;4` progress sequences are parsed natively. - **Desktop pill** — `(N · agg%)` title, collapsible animated trees, dismissals that persist, started/last-updated tooltips, and nudge telemetry. - **Guidance that adapts** — injected progress/relay rules, skill playbooks, pre-flight relay hints, strict-mode nudges for silent runs and stale progress, a turn-end idle reminder, and an optional 2-minute wall-clock nudge. - **Subagent attribution** — child work rolls up under the parent session, so it shows in the parent's pill instead of an orphaned scope. - **Four bundled skills** — `progress-tool`, `delegation`, `osc-demo`, and `tree-demo`, registered automatically. - **Automatic MCP registration** — installs and registers `@jakedowns/progress-tool-mcp` for you, with runtime detection (`node` → `bun` → `npx -y @jakedowns/progress-tool-mcp`) and an `mcpRuntime` option to pin the path. - **Configurable** — options for instruction injection, skill registration, MCP auto-registration, strict mode, wall-clock and idle nudges, auto-hide of completed tasks, bar style (`blocks` / `emoji`), refresh interval, and verbose JSONL telemetry. - **Persistent state** — lives in `~/.opencode-progress-state.json`, with opt-in retention (`PROGRESS_AUTO_PRUNE_S`) so the store doubles as a report. ## Links - **npm:** [@jakedowns/progress-tool-opencode-plugin on npmjs](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jakedowns/progress-tool-opencode-plugin) - Repository & full docs: - License: MIT --- ## 💛 Support If this plugin saves you time, donations are greatly appreciated — they keep it maintained and improving: - [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/jakedowns) - [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/jakedowns) - [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/jakedowns) - [Buy Me a Coffee](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/jakedowns) **Feedback & issues:** found a bug, have an idea, or want a feature? Open an [issue](https://github.com/jakedowns/progress-tool/issues) — reports and suggestions are welcome. **If you like it or find it useful, please ⭐ [star the repo](https://github.com/jakedowns/progress-tool) and share it on social media** — it's the easiest way to help more people discover it.
